screen.alpgmc.stats.title: Stats
class.alpgmc.warrior.penalty: Natural food healing reduced by 90%. Cannot use brewing stands.
class.alpgmc.warrior.bonus: Melee damage +40%, attack speed +20%, knockback resistance 50%, double output when crafting arrows.
class.alpgmc.archer.penalty: Cannot attack with weapons or tools, throw tridents, or craft arrows.
class.alpgmc.archer.bonus: Dedicated bow and arrows, bow damage +50%, 30% chance to save an arrow, move speed +15%, fall damage -50%.
class.alpgmc.mage.penalty: Can only wear Mage Robes. Cannot use anvils or smithing tables.
class.alpgmc.mage.bonus: Dedicated enchanting table that adds special enchantments to weapons and armor.
class.alpgmc.healer.penalty: All attack damage reduced by 90%, except damage from summons.
class.alpgmc.healer.bonus: Brews buff potions in a special stand, Regeneration aura, double natural healing, two upgradable summoned wolves.
class.alpgmc.tank.penalty: Cannot craft wearable armor. Move and mount speed reduced by 30%.
class.alpgmc.tank.bonus: Max health +20, damage taken -30%, knockback immunity, cheaper anvil repairs with no cost limit, Taunt skill.
